title: Local Minimax ATE Estimation with Surrogates and Vanishing Validation Probability
banked_reason: D0.5.G delivered tier=incremental below the field floor; paper_score_ceiling=5.8 < 7.4 and no bounded field-tier repair within scope.
gap_reasons: The note proves an exact variational local-minimax limit only for a highly specialized triangular class with known densities and baseline functions, exact power-law validation, binary residuals, compactly supported local perturbations, and randomized intervals.

The finite hierarchy converges in principle, but the reported witnesses include zero lower bounds and yield no informative bracket for either infinite-window constant, so the paper does not yet deliver the operational benchmark advertised to study planners.

The absence of an evaluated constant, practical allocation result, or application validating the model keeps the contribution narrow and constrains its leading-journal score despite the proved Poisson transfer and rate.
proof_attempt_summary: D0 derived the marked-Poisson decision transfer, signed-tail correction, finite certificate ledger, and two partition witnesses; D0.5 mathematical review passed after source attestation for finite LP strong duality. The field-tier promise collapsed at novelty review because the theorem covers a narrow known-law triangular class and the witnesses do not numerically identify informative infinite-window constants. A future re-raise would need a broader estimand/model transfer or substantive evaluated decision result, with the present graph and review retained as starting points.
tldr: In a deliberately narrow randomized triangular model with known arm densities, baseline regressions, validation law, and binary residual scale, validation probability \(c_aS^{\alpha}\) produces a continuous marked-Poisson local experiment when \(0\le\beta<\alpha-1\). The normalized causal ATE shift has exact infinite-window minimax MSE and uniformly honest randomized-interval squared-length values characterized by convergent ideal finite programs; signed \(L^2\) tail correction transfers them to the original data, and both squared criteria obey common-intensity exponent \(-(\beta+2)/(\alpha+1)\). An explicit outward verifier now composes coefficient enclosures, primal and dual residual repair, exact endpoint membership, coverage repair, partition and law errors, and original-data tails. Two exact rational two-bin certificates pass the prescribed early-kill test, but they are coarse composition witnesses, not sharp evaluated infinite-window constants.
gap: Regular surrogate-assisted ATE theory assumes enough validated outcomes for influence-function variance and Gaussian inference, while existing Poisson-functional and minimax-confidence methods do not address a continuous power-tail validation boundary with arbitrary measurable binary marks.
fill: The project derives the finite- and infinite-window decision experiments, proves sharp target-specific reductions and original-data minimax transfer, and supplies convergent two-sided programs whose final numerical-to-statistical certificate is posed as the explicit open problem.
